findings.text: blocking: the review branch resolves its subject run by looking up a node id in a map keyed by run id (plan_coordinator.py:152 and :156); a real review node id embeds the reviewed run's node id rather than its run id (reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:820 sets review_node_source to source_node), so round_node_source yields e.g. a-plans-coordinator-is-derived-from-the-ledger and the lookup misses, leaving every non-paired run review matched to no plan and the done-when's a run review through the run it reviews unmet.

follow-on: the fixture row mints the node id review-of-r-a1-a1b2c3d4e5f6, a run-id spelling the producer never emits (recovery_review_subject.py:820), so this case passes against the fixture rows hand-read by the fixture and not against a real row shape, and it survives the defect at plan_coordinator.py:122.

follow-on: the two declared negative controls at :393 and :415 build their failing input by mutating the resolved dict rather than running a broken resolver, so they hold the assertion helper's discrimination and not the code path the done-when names.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against 017b346cb4, 73decd0f4 adding reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py and its 442-line test and 20030d0d0 adding the 181-line evidence fragment, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_a_plans_coordinator_is_derived_from_the_ledger.py with three sibling files; the gate asserts the fixture pins, and its result is recorded in coordinator-head-arm.log and coordinator-base-arm.log.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to resolve each plan's coordinator session from its most recent dispatched run; reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py:186 resolve_plan_coordinators returns it for the plan, plan_link and plan-review-node matches, but the run-review match at plan_coordinator.py:122 resolves no plan on real ledger data.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md; it names commits 73decd0f4 and 20030d0d0, the literal gate command, both suite arms and four follow-ons, and its after_suite completed flag matches the coordinator's own four-file re-run in coordinator-head-arm.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the declared write paths, reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py, tests/test_a_plans_coordinator_is_derived_from_the_ledger.py, the landing fragment and a figures directory; the diff against 017b346cb4 touches the first three and nothing outside them.

justifications.evidence: the coordinator re-ran the named four-file gate at both revisions into coordinator-head-arm.log and coordinator-base-arm.log, and gate-plan-coordinator.log:16-21 carries the deciding row and matched field per plan the done_when asks for.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py:1 follows the surrounding style of reckon/crew/directory.py:1 and adds no plan, sprint or ticket identifier to a symbol, path or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py:186 resolve_plan_coordinators returns each plan's newest in-window coordinator for the plan, plan_link and plan-review-node matches, but the run-review match at plan_coordinator.py:122 resolves no plan on real ledger data.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/plan_coordinator.py:111 _plan_from_node re-implements the review-node-to-subject-run resolution already owned by reckon/crew/recovery_review_delivery.py:233 reviewed_run_id and reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:494 _reviewed_run_id, extending neither.
